# The Beyond: Thailand Travel Guide

> The Beyond's independent Thailand travel guide, written and fact-checked by The Beyond Editors. It covers cities and islands, regional Thai food, visa and TDAC entry rules, travel costs, flagship resorts and timely travel stories.

## Cities and regions
- [All destinations](https://thailand-travelguide.com/destinations/): Every city, island and region covered, grouped by area
- [Bangkok](https://thailand-travelguide.com/bangkok/): Temples, neighbourhoods, markets and nightlife in the capital
- [Chiang Mai](https://thailand-travelguide.com/chiang-mai/): Old City temples, night markets and mountain day trips
- [Phuket](https://thailand-travelguide.com/phuket/): Beach zones, island trips and where to base yourself
- [Krabi](https://thailand-travelguide.com/krabi/): Limestone coast, Railay and island hopping
- [Koh Samui](https://thailand-travelguide.com/koh-samui/): Gulf island beaches and resort areas
- [Pai](https://thailand-travelguide.com/pai/): Mountain valley town in the north
- [Pattaya](https://thailand-travelguide.com/pattaya/): Eastern Seaboard beach city
- [Top attractions](https://thailand-travelguide.com/attractions/): Grand Palace, Wat Arun, Maya Bay, Doi Suthep and more
- [Itineraries](https://thailand-travelguide.com/itineraries/): Day-by-day routes across the country

## Food
- [Thai food guide](https://thailand-travelguide.com/thai-food/): Regional dishes and where to eat them, city by city
- [Bangkok food](https://thailand-travelguide.com/thai-food/bangkok/): Signature Bangkok dishes and streets to try them
- [Chiang Mai food](https://thailand-travelguide.com/thai-food/chiang-mai/): Northern Thai specialities like khao soi and sai ua

## Visa and entry
- [Visas and TDAC](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/visas-and-tdac/): Visa exemption rules, proof of funds and the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card
- [TDAC checklist](https://thailand-travelguide.com/stories/tdac-thailand-digital-arrival-card-checklist/): Step-by-step arrival card checklist
- [Getting there](https://thailand-travelguide.com/get-there/): Routes between cities by air, train, bus and ferry

## Costs and practical planning
- [Money, ATMs and PromptPay](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/money-atms-and-promptpay/): Cash, card fees and everyday prices
- [eSIM and SIM cards](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/esim-and-sim-cards/): Mobile data options and costs
- [Grab and BTS](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/grab-and-bts/): Getting around Bangkok and fares
- [When to go](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/when-to-go/): Seasons, monsoon and burn season by region
- [Plan your trip](https://thailand-travelguide.com/plan/): All planning guides

## Resorts
- [Resort Living](https://thailand-travelguide.com/interests/resort-living/): Flagship resorts compared by beach zone and city

## Stories
- [Stories](https://thailand-travelguide.com/stories/): Timely travel news and seasonal updates
- [Loy Krathong and Yi Peng 2026 dates](https://thailand-travelguide.com/stories/loy-krathong-yi-peng-2026-dates/): Festival dates and where to go
- [Similan Islands 2026-27 season](https://thailand-travelguide.com/stories/similan-islands-open-2026-27-season/): Opening dates and access
